title: docs: fix API and guide links in Markdown exports
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Changed 13 links in the text, model, account, and introduction Markdown docs to use absolute gen.pollinations.ai URLs. Model catalog endpoints and guides for publishing models and agents, connecting wallets, public stats, MCP servers, and the CLI now point to the intended destination when the Markdown is read on GitHub or copied elsewhere.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden study, Polli repairs a link between an open Markdown book and a glowing API terminal, with small code-plants growing beside them. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and a tiny tool belt; she is small-to-medium within the scene, sharing the frame with the book and terminal, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients over warm cream, prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but emotionally warm.
